      org.apache.opendal.ServiceConfig.Azblob.batchMaxOperations
      Azblob delete batch capability is enabled by default with Azure Blob's 256-operation batch limit. Use CapabilityOverrideLayer to override delete_max_size for specific endpoints.
      org.apache.opendal.ServiceConfig.Cos.enableVersioning
      COS versioning capability is enabled by default and this option is no longer needed.
      org.apache.opendal.ServiceConfig.Gcs.allowAnonymous
      Please use `skip_signature` instead of `allow_anonymous`

      HDFS Native append capability is enabled by default and this option is no longer needed.

      OBS versioning capability is not controlled by this option and this option is no longer needed.
      org.apache.opendal.ServiceConfig.Onedrive.enableVersioning
      OneDrive supports version listing without this option.

      org.apache.opendal.ServiceConfig.S3.batchMaxOperations
      S3 delete batch capability is enabled by default. Use CapabilityOverrideLayer to override delete_max_size for specific endpoints.

      org.apache.opendal.ServiceConfig.S3.disableStatWithOverride

      org.apache.opendal.ServiceConfig.S3.enableVersioning

      org.apache.opendal.ServiceConfig.S3.enableWriteWithAppend

      org.apache.opendal.ServiceConfig.Sftp.enableCopy
      SFTP copy capability is enabled by default and this option is no longer needed.
      org.apache.opendal.ServiceConfig.Webdav.disableCopy
      WebDAV copy capability is enabled by default and this option is no longer needed.
      org.apache.opendal.ServiceConfig.Webdav.enableConditionalRead
      WebDAV conditional read capabilities are enabled by default. Use CapabilityOverrideLayer to override read_with_if_match, read_with_if_none_match, read_with_if_modified_since and read_with_if_unmodified_since for endpoints without ETag support.
      org.apache.opendal.ServiceConfig.Webdav.enableUserMetadata
      WebDAV user metadata capability is enabled by default. Use CapabilityOverrideLayer to override write_with_user_metadata for endpoints without PROPPATCH support.
